sloka: स शरैः पूरिततनुः क्रोधेन महता वृतः ।तमेव परिघं गृह्य भ्रामयामास वेगतः ।। ५.४४.१५।।।।
transliteration: sa śaraiḥ pūritatanuḥ krodhena mahatā vṛtaḥ ।tameva parighaṁ gṛhya bhrāmayāmāsa vegataḥ ।। 5.44.15।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman filled with arrows all over his body, seized an iron spear (which he made use of in the initial battle) and impetuously spun it in intense anger.
